pages.text_description:
[color=#FFC700]Inventory[/color] [color=#FDFDFD]— the main place where your items are stored.

You can obtain all the necessary items in the game world or purchase them in Convenience Stores. When the Inventory is full, acquired items are placed into Loot. Both the Inventory and the Loot list can be opened through the tablet menu.

Remember: the Inventory capacity is not unlimited, but it can be expanded with special accessories that increase the number of slots.[/color]

[color=#FDFDFD]Vehicles need to be refueled regularly. If the fuel tank runs empty, the trip will end.

There are many gas stations located throughout the game world where you can always refuel your vehicle, as well as buy a fuel canister to top up right on the road. But remember that different vehicles require different types of fuel![/color]

[color=#FDFDFD]Congratulations! You have successfully completed the starter tutorial, and the most interesting part is still ahead of you!

Develop your character by completing Uncle Slava's tasks.

Earn money at jobs or start your own business.

Join various organizations and climb the career ladder.

Buy and upgrade dozens of types of transport[/color]

[color=#FDFDFD]Create families and bring entire districts under your influence.

Buy and improve your own real estate.

Communicate and interact with other players thanks to voice chat.

Take part in events, complete daily tasks, level up the Black Pass, and receive unique content.

A gift has been added to the Loot section for completing the starter tutorial. Welcome![/color]

[color=#FFC700]Ice Fall[/color] [color=#FDFDFD]— ice fall.

You can obtain all the necessary items in the game world or purchase them in Convenience Stores. When the Inventory is full, acquired items are placed into Loot. Both the Inventory and the Loot list can be opened through the tablet menu.

Remember: the Inventory capacity is not unlimited, but it can be expanded with special accessories that increase the number of slots.[/color]

[color=#FFC700]Battle with the Plague Doctors.[/color] [color=#FDFDFD]— a battle with the plague doctors.

You will have to neutralize members of the Plague Doctor squad. Make snowballs from the snowdrifts of Bumstown and aim straight at the bandits. But keep in mind, the snowdrifts are limited!

Remember: The bandits will throw various objects at you. Dodge them so you do not take heavy damage.[/color]

pages.text_title: Stealth mode: avoid the spotlight beams
pages.text_description: Careful! Getting caught in a spotlight beam will instantly reveal your location to the guards. The red zone is dangerous. If you end up in a lit area, you will be spotted and the mission will fail. Move between covers and stay out of the spotlight beams.

Attention! During the chase, the car takes damage in collisions. Watch the durability indicator. 60–40% — the car is damaged. 30% — the mission will fail. Maneuver, evade the pursuit, and take care of the car.

Flipper is a device for intercepting car radio signals. Activate it to begin scanning.

Codes from different cars will appear in the center of the screen, and at the bottom there will be a hint with the parameters of the required signal.

Your task is to find the matching code and select it. The correct signal will unlock the car; if you make a mistake, try again.

Attention! During the chase, the car takes damage in collisions. Watch the durability indicator. 60–40% — the car is damaged. 30% — the mission will fail. Maneuver, evade the pursuit, and take care of the car.

Barrels are placed on the track — your task is to knock them down by driving near them.
Try to move accurately and control your trajectory.

Each knocked-down barrel increases progress.
Knock down enough and you will win the race.

Watch the road and do not miss the targets.

Follow the checkpoints and finish faster than everyone else. When the leader crosses the finish line, the others will have 60 seconds. Those who do not make it in time will receive DNF status and a reward penalty.
You can leave the race at any time using the exit button or the /racequit command. Leaving early applies a penalty: the queue for a new race will be unavailable for some time.

Follow the checkpoints and finish faster than everyone else. When the leader crosses the finish line, the others will have 60 seconds. Those who do not make it in time will receive DNF status (did not finish) and part of the reward.
You can leave the race at any time using the exit button or the /racequit command. Leaving early applies a penalty: the queue for a new race will be unavailable for some time.

After each lap, the last of the players is eliminated and takes a place according to the elimination order. The reward is granted according to the place taken. Stay with the main pack and watch the HUD notifications.
You can leave the race at any time using the exit button or the /racequit command. Leaving early applies a penalty: the queue for a new race will be unavailable for some time.
The track is divided into segments. At the end of each segment, the last participant is eliminated. The remaining two race to the finish: whoever crosses first wins.
You can leave the race at any time using the exit button or the /racequit command. Leaving early applies a penalty: the queue for a new race will be unavailable for some time.
The race class is determined by the free car of the week. Choose it or a car from your garage. Tuning improves characteristics and can move the car into another class.
A duel on special tracks — score as many points as possible to win! The longer you stay in a skid, the stronger your point multiplier becomes. Do not spare the tires!

The Battle for Containers is an [color=#FFC700]auction[/color] where you can see the reward type, country, and starting bid for each container. Inside there may be a reward worth many times more than the starting bid.

[color=#FFC700]Outbid[/color] your competitors, and if the timer runs out and no one outbids your offer, the [color=#FFC700]container is yours[/color]. You can immediately sell your winnings to the state or take them as loot.

In place of a redeemed container, a [color=#FFC700]new one appears[/color]. The battle does not last long — keep an eye on the chat.

If during a single auction all of you together redeem the required number of containers, access to bidding for the [color=#FFC700]Diplomatic Cargo[/color] will open.

The auctions take place in [color=#FFC700]Arzamas[/color] at the [color=#FFC700]30th minute of every hour[/color].
Look for the container on the map or via [color=#FFC700]GPS → Entertainment → Battle for Containers[/color]. Sometimes special auctions are held — follow social media and check in with Oleg Rubtsov.
Use the sound and the indicator in the objective on the right as your guide. The closer you are to the phone, the louder the sound. Get closer to the phone to spot it.
Shoot the bandits and their vehicles to disable the blockade they created. Just don't get too close, what if it blows up?
Use the flashlight to find and highlight important clues. To use the flashlight, you only need to aim your view at objects while in aiming position.
You can take the passenger seat by pressing the button with the door icon. To get into the driver's seat, press the button with the car icon..
Hold your finger on the vehicle to open the radial vehicle control menu. With it, you can control the vehicle's engine, lights, and doors.
Keep an eye on your health. Come to a 24/7 store, buy a first aid kit, and use it through your inventory. To use the first aid kit, just press and hold your finger on it and select 'Use'.
Keep track of your hunger through the [color=#FFC700]inventory[/color]. Eat at [color=#FFC700]stalls[/color] and [color=#FFC700]snack bars[/color] to always stay full of energy and health.

[color=#FDFDFD]In addition, transport can take damage from collisions with the environment and other road users. And a completely broken vehicle will be permanently immobilized.

To repair it, use repair kits. You can always buy them at gas stations or 24/7 stores. After purchase, the repair kit will be stored in your inventory.[/color]

[color=#FFC700]Overcome obstacles[/color]: on-foot parkour and car races. If you fall, you will start from the last [color=#FFC700]save zone[/color]. Attempts are unlimited.

The higher your place, the [color=#FFC700]greater your reward[/color]. Try to take first place!

Finish the level within the allotted time, otherwise the reward will not be granted.

A game with a team objective - [color=#FFC700]break into the vault[/color] and [color=#FFC700]infect the computer[/color] of the other team of thieves.

The team that [color=#FFC700]infects more computers in 3 rounds[/color] becomes the [color=#FFC700]winner[/color] of the game and takes the jackpot.

[color=#FFC700]Collect chips[/color] around the room and use them to raise additional protection.

During the event, receive [color=#FFC700]100 Chips[/color] in the casino along with your regular winnings in the games:

• Black Jack
• Dice
• Durak

The daily limit from each game is [color=#FFC700]300 chips[/color].
The limit resets every day at 5:00 MSK. Chips are collected with the maximum limit of mini-games in the event taken into account and include all event track multipliers.

Take part in the [color=#FFC700]Gift Drop[/color]:

• Find the [color=#FFC700]Master of Luck[/color] at the stations and at Kristall's party
• Keep an eye on the drop timer 
• Make it to the location before the drop ends and grab up to 3 prizes each drop!
• Take part every hour and get the maximum number of gifts
• A chance to win valuable prizes: Chips, BC, and even Kozyr and Ace cases!
